mapper.select:
SELECT l.memsuspended_id as memsuspendedId, l.user_id as userId, u.nickname, l.suspended_reason as suspendedReason, l.suspended_startdate as suspendedStartDate, l.suspended_enddate as suspendedEndDate FROM tblMemSuspended l JOIN tblUser u ON l.user_id = u.user_id WHERE l.suspended_enddate > SYSDATE
ORDER BY l.suspended_startdate DESC
